# QR generator

`qrcode-generator-2.0.4.mjs` is the unmodified `dist/qrcode.mjs` from
[qrcode-generator 2.0.4](https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator).
License: MIT, included in `qrcode-generator-LICENSE`.
Upstream revision: `83b7e8fe3fddd3b0368dbafd6ce56995bd25e3c8`.

Archive: https://registry.npmjs.org/qrcode-generator/-/qrcode-generator-2.0.4.tgz
Verified SHA-512 (base64):
`mZSiP6RnbHl4xL2Ap5HfkjLnmxfKcPWpWe/c+5XxCuetEenqmNFf1FH/ftXPCtFG5/TDobjsjz6sSNL0Sr8Z9g==`

The browser loads this local module only when the QR option is opened.
No external image service or CDN receives the session link.
